key_facts: On Sep. 14, 2026, TaskUs sent Brendan Nforbi an offer of employment for Teammate, Team Lead QA, via Adobe Sign to his personal email (bnn.cdl@gmail.com), with onboarding tasks in WorkDay. The same day he signed the United States Background Consent Form consenting to release of background-screening information to TaskUs USA LLC for employment-eligibility determination, and the Non-Disclosure and Invention Assignment Agreement with TaskUs Holdings, Inc. A TaskUs welcome graphic ('You + Us = Ridiculously Good Journey') accompanied the packet. No background-check vendor is named in the packet, no report has been furnished, and no adverse action has occurred.
note: Prospective Cluster 5 employment matter. The file ripens only if TaskUs runs the background check and takes adverse action on registry information.
